summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with SHACLPathError and parse_shacl_path(shapes_graph, path_identifier), and test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py with parametrized valid, invalid, and non-node tests. The new tests and test/test_path.py pass (41 passed) under the prepared venv. Nothing was committed. Not verified: mypy is not installed in the venv, so the type-check gate and black/ruff/isort were not run; type-ignore placement and formatting were applied by reading the code. Also, the venv's editable rdflib install points at base/, so tests only exercised this repo's module when run from this directory with pytest.
